subject.title: improve: index transcript mirror persistence checks

question: Should OpenClaw publish `withSessionTranscriptIndexedWriteLock` and its three mirror-oriented persistence facts as a supported Plugin SDK contract, or should the optimization remain behind an owner-controlled internal seam?
rationale: The implementation adds a new public package subpath and durable Plugin SDK methods; source-level correctness cannot determine the intended external support boundary or deprecation commitment.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow public SDK contract
options.body: Approve the indexed lock as a generic supported transcript API, then require current-head proof and focused compatibility tests before merge.

options.title: Keep the optimization internal
options.body: Refactor the indexed queries behind an owner-controlled core or bundled-plugin seam so external plugins do not inherit a mirror-specific contract.

options.title: Pause the follow-up
options.body: Leave the existing full-read behavior until a broader transcript SDK design has an explicit owner and external-plugin use case.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow public SDK contract
recommendation.body: Approve the indexed lock as a generic supported transcript API, then require current-head proof and focused compatibility tests before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the linked transcript foundation and authored the API follow-up, so they are the best available routing candidate for the design discussion.
